interface.longDescription: Connect your authorized Snipara project to retrieve focused source context and reviewed project memory. Sign in through the assistant's native OAuth flow and explicitly choose one accessible project. Ask questions about your documentation, inspect the cited source sections, and recall reviewed prior decisions. A Snipara account and project access are required. The plugin is free; any Snipara subscription is purchased separately on snipara.com. This directory package provides Hosted MCP and context/memory skills. The separate native Claude Code/Codex package connects each repository through a source-bound local component. Optional Companion and Orchestrator capabilities require separate runtime installation, an explicit project profile and independent authentication; the native source connection does not authorize their hosted execution.
